meta.notes: A villager_trade tag gives one name to several villager_trade ids. values lists ids or other tags (written #namespace:path); set replace to true only to wipe what other packs put in a tag of the same id. A trade set draws its trades from a tag ("trades": "#msm_examples:arrow_trades"). To offer a trade to a vanilla villager, add it to the vanilla tag of its profession and level, such as minecraft:fletcher/level_1, without replace.
